items.q: How do I book a ride with AB.Limo?
items.a: Booking is simple. Use our website or mobile app to enter your pickup and drop-off locations, select your vehicle class, and confirm your reservation. You'll receive instant confirmation and real-time updates.

items.q: What areas does AB.Limo operate in?
items.a: We operate in over 60 countries and 500+ cities worldwide, including major cities across the Middle East, Europe, Asia, and North America.

items.q: Can I schedule rides in advance?
items.a: Yes, you can schedule rides up to 60 days in advance. This is perfect for airport transfers, business meetings, and special events.
We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and digital payment methods. Corporate accounts can also be set up for business travel.

items.q: Is AB.Limo available for corporate accounts?
items.a: Absolutely. We offer tailored corporate solutions with dedicated account management, consolidated billing, and preferential rates for businesses of all sizes.

meta.title: Sustainability - AB.Limo | Driving a Greener Future
meta.description: AB.Limo is committed to sustainability through electric vehicles, carbon offsetting, and net-zero initiatives.

hero.desc: Our commitment to the planet goes beyond compliance. We're actively shaping a sustainable future for luxury ground transportation.

ev.p1: Electric vehicles are no longer the future — they're the present. At AB.Limo, we're accelerating our transition to a fully electric fleet, ensuring every ride contributes to cleaner air and quieter cities.
ev.p2: From Tesla Model S and Mercedes EQS to BMW iX, our growing EV fleet delivers the same luxury experience with zero tailpipe emissions. We're investing heavily in charging infrastructure to ensure seamless coverage across all our operating markets.

carbonOffset.p1: Every ride taken with AB.Limo is fully carbon offset. We invest in verified carbon reduction projects — from reforestation in the Amazon to renewable energy installations in Sub-Saharan Africa.
carbonOffset.p2: Our partnership with South Pole ensures that every ton of CO2 emitted is matched with high-quality carbon credits, making your journey with us climate-positive.

items.name: South Pole
items.desc: Leading carbon offsetting partner helping us neutralize emissions through verified projects worldwide.

items.name: Cooper Parry
items.desc: Ensuring accountability and transparency in our sustainability reporting and carbon accounting.

items.name: The Climate Pledge
items.desc: Founding signatory committed to reaching net-zero carbon emissions by 2040.

items.name: World Alliance
items.desc: Founding member collaborating with global leaders to accelerate climate action.

steps.title: Electric Vehicles
steps.desc: Transitioning our entire fleet to electric vehicles across all major markets by 2030.

steps.title: Carbon Offsetting
steps.desc: 100% of our emissions are offset through verified carbon credit programs.

steps.title: Net-Zero Commitment
steps.desc: Committed to achieving net-zero emissions by 2040 through the Climate Pledge.

climateStrikes.p1: We believe in using our voice and platform to advocate for systemic change. AB.Limo actively participates in global climate strikes and supports policy initiatives that accelerate the transition to a low-carbon economy.
climateStrikes.p2: Our team members are encouraged to engage in sustainability activism, and we provide paid time off for climate-related volunteer activities and community events.

quote.text: Sustainability isn't a department or a initiative — it's embedded in everything we do. Every ride we provide is a step towards a cleaner, more sustainable future for ground transportation.
quote.name: The AB.Limo Leadership Team
quote.subtitle: Driving sustainability forward

app.desc: Download the AB.Limo app and choose sustainable luxury at your fingertips. See real-time carbon offset data for every ride, track your personal sustainability impact, and join us in driving change.

items.a: Yes. Our white-label solution allows you to present the chauffeur booking experience under your own brand, maintaining consistency with your agency's identity.

items.q: What support do you provide to partners?
items.a: Partners receive a dedicated success manager, 24/7 technical support, marketing materials, and access to our partner portal with training resources.
